name: Eleanor Ashcroft
source:
Eleanor is MC's aunt, the owner of the mansion, and is currently deceased.
Coming from a wealthy family, she was a curious and intelligent woman who did not have the opportunity to study formally given the conditions of the era in which she lived. An avid reader, she began to study on her own.
